HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:WAR ZONE (6) was very aggressively driven after commencing from the second row and peaked late when ninth at Melton last outing. He was a big winner at Melton on July 24 when he led throughout in a mile rate of 1.55.3 and he is a good chance of finding the lead again here so a bold showing is expected. BETTORSWEETVICTORY (9) raced without cover throughout and battled on well for fifth behind Madam Reactor at Shepparton eight days ago. She follows out behind a fast beginner and should gain an economical trip so she looms as one of the leading chances. SKYZ ABOVE (3) won twice in succession at Ballarat prior to an eighth behind Know The Score, where he was picking up ground from last. He is much better drawn than last week and is worth another chance. MIDNIGHT MOJO (7) has a tough draw to overcome but she is usually competitive against this class and could show up without surprising. SELECTIONS: WAR ZONE (6), BETTORSWEETVICTORY (9), SKYZ ABOVE (3), MIDNIGHT MOJO (7)

OVERVIEW:CO CAPTAIN (5) returns to Victoria after a Queensland campaign, where he took out the Derby/Qaks Consolation at his latest performance. He won a trial after dashing home in a last quarter of 27.3 seconds at Melton last week and he should prove hard to beat again. COVERED IN GOLD (9) has won three of his past four starts and looms as a danger to his stable mate. He finished off smartly to score in a slick mile rate of 1.54.9 at Shepparton last outing. ONE GOLDEN DEAL (7) is an interesting runner. She hasn’t started since beating a strong field at Horsham in May and hasn’t been to the trials. She recorded a mile rate of 1.54.7 at Melton in April so she has the speed to test this field. BETTOR PUNTER (4) is racing in peak form and has claims along with VINNY ROCK (2) and LET’S GO LORNA (6), which beat the smart pacer Secret Service Agent (won since) at her latest victory. BACK: CO CAPTAIN (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: CO CAPTAIN (5), COVERED IN GOLD (9), ONE GOLDEN DEAL (7), LET’S GO LORNA (6)

OVERVIEW: BINALONG MATE (5) is stepping up in class from his latest Melton victory but he did score impressively and his overall form is strong. He is a versatile pacer and is capable of taking the next step forward. OUT TO STAY (1) has been a little below his best form since resuming but his latest fourth after working hard at Hamilton was encouraging and he has the class to test this field if he can hold a forward position at the start. ALLGOOD VINNIE (3) holds the key to the event. He is a brilliant beginner and has won twice recently after leading out then taking cover so he is likely to try and adopt similar tactics here. ROCKELLA (4) was caught wide early and dropped back to a rearward position so he didn’t have much luck at his latest unplaced run. He was held up for a run and should have finished closer when fourth prior so he is racing better than his form reads. SELECTIONS: BINALONG MATE (5), OUT TO STAY (1), ALLGOOD VINNIE (3), ROCKELLA (4)

OVERVIEW: IM EDDIE (3) is a strong type, which worked forward to find the lead and battled on gamely for a close second at Ballarat last outing. He is a good chance of finding the lead again and is capable of going one better. CONSTANT (1) lacks early dash and is likely to be headed off the start but his first up second was encouraging as he hit the line strongly. METRO SWISH (4) appeared to have her chance after setting up a slow tempo in the lead at her latest third but she has been placed in four of her past five starts and she is drawn to gain a prominent position again. BLACKRANGE GLORY (8) is a very smart horse when he is able to put it altogether and is a winning chance if he delivers a fool proof display. He has been freshened after missing away from the standing start and finishing unplaced at Horsham last outing. SELECTIONS: IM EDDIE (3), CONSTANT (1), METRO SWISH (4), BLACKRANGE GLORY (8)

OVERVIEW:COOL STORY (8) was held up for a run at a vital stage and stormed home for an eye-catching second at Melton then finished off stoutly in quick final sectionals at his latest fifth. He is racing in top form and strikes a suitable assignment so he is likely to be confidently supported. The interesting runner is STORM VENDETTA (4). He produced a career best performance to win in a mile rate of 1.56.0 at the end of last season then was sent to Tasmania but didn’t fire in four attempts. He returns to Victoria and has the early speed to be prominent throughout. ROYAL ROCKSTAR (6) is a fast beginner and was able to break through for a win after leading throughout at Ballarat. He is stepping up in class for this assignment but should go well again. YANKEE MOJOH (3) and BUNGY (7) are both worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: COOL STORY (8) – 4 units (wIn) SELECTIONS: COOL STORY (8), STORM VENDETTA (4), ROYAL ROCKSTAR (6), BUNGY (7)

OVERVIEW:ESPERANZA (8) appeared to have every chance after gaining the one out and one back trail when sixth behind Spun Silver at Melton last outing but she will appreciate a slight drop back in grade and has the services of ace reinsman James Herbertson so she is worth another chance. ATOMIC GLORY (5) is a good chance of finding the lead shortly after the start and was runner up in a race of similar standard at Cranbourne two starts ago so he warrants respect. He didn’t enjoy the best of luck at his latest unplaced run behind Final Bow, where he worked hard in the run. THE FEENY FAVORITE (7) went forward from a similar wide draw and battled on well for third at Melton last week. He is an experienced maiden but this is no harder than his latest handy performance. SILVER DOMINO (1) was safely held when resuming but he has been competitive against stronger opposition previously and he should be fitter this time around. SELECTIONS: ESPERANZA (8), ATOMIC GLORY (5), THE FEENY FAVORITE (7), SILVER DOMINO (1)

OVERVIEW: JOE LOU (6) has been in fine form having won three of his past four starts including an incredible victory at Melton on July 15, where he broke stride early and came from tailed off. He worked forward to find the lead and scored comfortably at Melton last outing so there is no reason why he can’t win again. SHAQ THE ANVIL (4) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and had no luck after being checked at the 400m mark when unplaced at Melton last outing. He finished third behind the in-form trotter Spirited Lass prior and he looms as a strong winning chance. SNICKERS EXPRESS (5) is working into some form with placed efforts behind Rastamon and Off Your Faceski at his past two starts. He should gain a nice trail just off the speed and is not without a chance. WHATS THE TEA (7) and I AM SKYE CHIOLA (8) are both racing well enough to figure in the finish. SELECTIONS: JOE LOU (6), SHAQ THE ANVIL (4), SNICKERS EXPRESS (5), WHATS THE TEA (7)

OVERVIEW: SHONEE (3) is a promising trotter, which has been placed in all of her four starts since resuming from a spell. She led out then took cover and chased hard when second behind the smart type Keayang Tweetybird at Terang last outing and is capable of going one better here. CHAMPAGNES (2) continues her impressive form line having won four of her past five starts. She led throughout and scored by a large margin, seemingly with plenty in reserve at Kilmore last outing. This is a race of more depth but she should prove hard to beat again. NO TELLING HEATHER (1) was runner up behind CHAMPAGNES (2) at her last attempt and is perfectly drawn to run a good race again. VANCE LANE (6) pushed forward to find the lead and was run down late in handy time when resuming. He has struck trouble in three efforts since and has claims if he puts in a fool proof display. BACK: SHONEE (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SHONEE (3), CHAMPAGNES (2), NO TELLING HEATHER (1), VANCE LANE (6)

OVERVIEW: FREMARKS ELITE (3) is making his debut for trainer Courtney Slater and shaped up nicely at a Melton trial effort last week, where he was beaten by a narrow margin in reasonable time. He obviously has ability and is worth following. THE TROUT COD (5) was resuming since April and having his first run for trainer Ross Graham when a handy third at Shepparton last outing. She should be fitter from that run and is worth an investment. THE PASO DOBLE (2) has been placed in four out of his past five starts and should give another honest account. He possesses early speed and finished second after trailing the leader throughout last outing. ALCOMBZ (6) has ability but is still learning. He was slow to begin and had excuses last time and finished third behind Pique at Ballarat prior. SELECTIONS: FREMARKS ELITE (3), THE TROUT COD (5), THE PASO DOBLE (2), ALCOMBZ (6)

OVERVIEW:ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5) has been freshened since a disappointing seventh at Kilmore in July. Her form prior was strong and she will take beating if she can return to her peak form. THE ITALIAN DREAM (6) finished off nicely when fourth behind BUSLIN BRODY (8) at Kilmore last week. She is trotting consistently and should be competitive again. BUSLIN BRODY (8) settled three back on the markers and finished off best via the sprint lane when he scored at Kilmore last week. He is awkwardly drawn on the inside of the second line but this is a field of similar quality so he must be considered as a winning chance again. CLASSIC FAIR (10) galloped and lost his chance when resuming but he finished a close second behind Little Miss Morgan at a Cobram trial since so he is capable of better. TWEEDLEDEE (9) settled four back on the markers and burst home late when a game second behind Vici Bloom at Melton last week. He hasn’t won in 39 starts for the season but he appears to be very well graded with a claiming price of $8,000 in this event so he cannot be discarded. SELECTIONS: ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5), THE ITALIAN DREAM (6), BUSLIN BRODY (8), CLASSIC FAIR (10)

OVERVIEW:BET BET HOTSHOT (1) was headed off at the start and ended up being three back on the markers before finishing off well for second behind FLING IT RAINBOW (7) last week. He might end up being behind the leader here and will be dangerous via the sprint lane. PIQUE (9) made several errors and lost her chance when unplaced at Kilmore last outing. She ran a game race when second behind Keayang Minnesota at Ballarat prior and she was runner up behind the classy 2yo trotter Phoenix Red on July 24 so she is worth another chance. AGAINST THE BRIDLE (8) pushed forward to race without cover and faded into seventh at Kilmore last outing. His form prior was sound and this is a drop back in class so he is worth an investment. FLING IT RAINBOW (7) began quickly and ended up being behind the leader when he got home best to win at Kilmore last week. He has a tough draw to overcome but he won comfortably last time out. SELECTIONS: BET BET HOTSHOT (1), PIQUE (9), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (8), FLING IT RAINBOW (7)

OVERVIEW: STERLING GIGI (6) began quickly but ended up being shuffled to three back on the markers when he chased hard for second behind Kings Gallery at Melton last week. He has shown promise during his juvenile season and this appears to be a very suitable assignment. JUST MY LUCK (7) is resuming but won a trial in reasonable time at Cobram last week and is capable of showing up without surprising. ROCKINTHEKASBA (8) had every chance and dropped out from the 400m when ninth on this track at his first run since April. He performed much better in a trial prior with a runaway success so an improved showing would not surprise. DONTTELLNANNA (9) settled in a rearward position and did well over the final 200m to pick up half of the field at Cranbourne on Sunday. She is better than her form reads and rates as a value hope. ASHANTE CADMAN (5) led out then took cover when second behind Beau Beca last week. He is likely to adopt similar tactics here and is worth a ticket each way. BACK: STERLING GIGI (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: STERLING GIGI (6), JUST MY LUCK (7), ROCKINTHEKASBA (8), DONTTELLNANNA (9)

OVERVIEW: KINGS GALLERY (10) is a very smart juvenile pacer, which was runner up at his first four attempts and resumed with a dominant victory at Melton last week. He is taking on older horses this evening but he appears to have a very promising future. BLUE MIKI (7) circled around the field from the middle of the pack to race without cover and battled on strongly for second behind Hez Harrywho seven days ago. He is versatile and is racing consistently so he looms as one of the leading chances again. TOOBY GOLD (6) commenced from the inside of the second line and was shuffled back to seventh early before finishing off fast for an eye-catching second behind Spun Silver last week. This race is slightly tougher but she is capable of running into a place again. MIKI MARK (8) was also caught on the markers after commencing from the inside of the second line last week and didn’t have much luck. He is racing well and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: KINGS GALLERY (10) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: KINGS GALLERY (10), BLUE MIKI (7), TOOBY GOLD (6), MIKI MARK (8)

OVERVIEW:THESTING (6) is resuming since January but he has had four recent trial performances so he should be somewhere near his peak fitness. His four race track starts to date were in the Homegrown Classic series, the Graham Head Memorial and the Holloway Classic so he appears to be well placed against this field. ARCHAA (3) is a fast beginner and has been racing in fine form at Kilmore with four wins and three placed efforts from his past seven starts. He attempted to lead throughout and ran along at a genuine tempo when third behind Shazza Love seven days ago. LIBERTY STAR DUST (8) settled in the second half of the field and produced a big finish when a game third at his first run since May. He has ability and is worth following. UNCLE TREV (5) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off nicely for third behind Madam Reactor at Shepparton last week. That was his first up run since June and he should strip fitter so he must be included amongst the leading chances. FROSTY DROP (7) led throughout at a Cranbourne victory on June 14 and met a strong field at her latest sixth. She is poorly drawn but has the ability to figure in the finish. BACK: THESTING (6) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: THESTING (6), ARCHAA (3), LIBERTY STAR DUST (8), UNCLE TREV (5)

OVERVIEW:PASS THE SALT (5) was resuming since a sixth in the Homegrown Classic in December when he raced without cover throughout and proved to be too strong at Kilmore last week. He should strip fitter from that performance and is a winning chance again despite rising in class. OX KNOX (6) was heavily supported and led throughout to score comfortably over Buslin Brody (won since) at Melton. He has returned from a break in good form and should prove hard to beat again. CALL ME JACK (7) will appreciate a drop back in grade from his recent efforts and he is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward. He is likely to settle in a rearward position early but will be suited if there is a genuine tempo throughout. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4) is a speedy mare that finished a close second last week after leading out then taking cover. She is likely to adopt similar tactics here and has winning claims. SELECTIONS: PASS THE SALT (5), OX KNOW (6), CALL ME JACK (7), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4)

OVERVIEW: MOISSANITE (7) is still learning and has gait issues but he has the ability to test this field. He was slow to begin and lost approximately 30m before circling around the field to race without cover when a big third behind Callinan at Ballarat. MI BOW (5) was checked at the start and lost several lengths before settling at the back of the pack then sustained a long run from the 800m when a creditable third last outing. She has been placed in five of her past six starts and deserves to break through for a win. LEZAMA (4) gained a nice trail early and was left stranded without cover from the bell when second behind Sambezia last outing. She has also been racing consistently with four placed efforts from her past five starts and warrants respect. DELTA GEE (1) is a first starter for trainer Kari Males, which finished third at a Kilmore trial effort last week and must be kept safe. BACK: MOISSANITE (7) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: MOISSANITE (7), MI BOW (5), LEZAMA (4), DELTA GEE (1)

OVERVIEW:JUST INCREDIBLE (6) is racing in great form and looms as the horse to beat. He worked hard in the run and went down fighting when a brave second behind the smart pacer Don Crunch at Mildura on August 07. STARVIN MARVIN (2) began quickly to lead and held off his rivals to win at Mildura two weeks ago and is a good chance of finding the lead again so he cannot be dismissed. CALF PEN (1) is racing well below his best form but this is his best draw for some time and he is a possible improver. CAULONIA TERROR (3) came from last and hit the line strongly for fourth behind Cheers Poverty last week. He has recently dropped down into this class and went well enough last week to warrant consideration. HELLAVA DEAL (4) will be fitter from her first up run since May and has the ability to show up prominently. BACK: JUST INCREDIBLE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: JUST INCREDIBLE (6), STARVIN MARVIN (2), CALF PEN (1), CAULONIA TERROR (3)

OVERVIEW:SNEAKY PHILTRA (7) has had three wins and two seconds from her past six starts and sustained a long run out three horses wide from the bell when a game second behind Whitehaven Beach last week. She is a versatile mile and should take beating against this class. ACCELERE (4) was competing at Mildura back in 2023 before heading to New South Wales and Queensland. He is resuming since a second behind Artistic Saint at Redcliffe, where he settled three back on the markers and gained a one out and one back trail before the home turn. He did well when he last competed locally and he won a trial on Monday night so a bold showing would not surprise. HESASTAR (5) pushed forward to race without cover and battled on fairly for fourth at Mildura last outing. He produced a strong performance to win at Mildura prior and he should be close to the pace again here. PUNTO CALIENTE (1) settled in a rearward position, sprinted quickly down the back straight and sustained the run to win nicely last week. This is a race of more depth but he is drawn to go well again. BACK: SNEAKY PHILTRA (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SNEAKY PHILTRA (7), ACCELERE (4), HESASTAR (5), PUNTO CALIENTE (1)

OVERVIEW: FORTY LOVE (4) was resuming since June when he went down fighting after doing all of the work in the run at his latest close third. He should strip fitter from that run and has the best draw out of the major chances so he warrants respect. DON LOU (5) made a good impression at his first run since coming from Queensland and will prove hard to beat again. He settled down midfield, came out four horses wide on the home turn and produced a big finish to defeat a field of similar standard. HOT DEAL (6) was a game winner over Ultimate Vinnie at Horsham prior to a close second behind DON LOU (5). He appeared to have his chance last outing but his record at Mildura is strong and he is tough enough to be in the finish. MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (1) will appreciate his best draw for some time and he has won several races under these conditions at Mildura previously so he is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: FORTY LOVE (4), DON LOU (5), HOT DEAL (6), MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (1)

OVERVIEW: YOU’VE BEEN SERVED (7) finished strongly from three back on the markers and missed out by a narrow margin at her debut then battled on strongly after racing in the death seat at her latest Mildura performance. She is a promising filly and appears to be well placed against this class. CAPTIVATE ME (5) led out then took cover when second behind My Ultimate Henry last week. He is a good chance of finding the lead despite his wide draw and he should prove hard to catch. CRUEL MISTRESS (1) was headed off at the start and moved away from the markers to race without cover from the 1500m when third under similar conditions last week. She is ideally drawn and is not without a chance. ULTIMATE ADVICE (6) is widely drawn but should have benefited from the experience of her debut performance last week and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: YOU’VE BEEN SERVED (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: YOU’VE BEEN SERVED (7), CAPTIVATE ME (5), CRUEL MISTRESS (1), ULTIMATE ADVICE (6)

OVERVIEW:LETSGO BIG GIRL (7) was disappointing at her latest sixth at Mildura but she performs much better over the sprint distance and this is a significant drop back in class. She recorded a sizzling mile rate of 1.56.4 when she scored at Mildura on July 10, which is a good form pointer for this event. WATCH THE ATTITUDE (5) produced a career best performance when she led throughout in a mile rate of 1.56.5 two weeks ago then followed with a second behind King Saint last week. She is a versatile mare and is worth an investment. BIGBASHASH (4) progressed forward to find the lead and won at Horsham two starts ago then endured a tough run at her latest unplaced performance. She is likely to give a forward showing from her reasonable draw. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6) is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward and is racing consistently against this class so she is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: LETSGO BIG GIRL (7), WATCH THE ATTITUDE (5), BIGBASHASH (4), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6)

OVERVIEW:KEAYANG CRIPPA (4) progressed forward to race without cover and battled on fairly well for fourth behind Punto Caliente seven days ago. He is racing in good form and is a chance of finding the lead from his reasonable draw so he should prove hard to beat. EGBERT (5) is another fast beginner drawn on the front line and is working back into his peak form. He came from midfield and finished off well for a close second behind Punto Caliente last week. ALIENFROMARMSTRONG (8) was heavily supported and attempted to lead throughout when a disappointing sixth at Mildura last week. He was held up for a run at a vital stage when second prior and he came from off the speed to win at Mildura on July 10 so he is worth another chance. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was placed in two attempts at Mildura back in 2021/22 and is returning from a long stay in the Sunshine State. He hasn’t been in the best of form of late but he does strike a suitable assignment first up for trainer Tori Hutchins. BACK: KEAYANG CRIPPA (4) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: KEAYANG CRIPPA (4), EGBERT (5), ALIENFROMARMSTRONG (8), MAJOR LINCOLN (7)

OVERVIEW: WHITEHAVEN BEACH (7) broke through for a deserved victory at Mildura last week, where he progressed forward to find the lead and kicked on too well in the run to the finish. He is awkwardly drawn but is one of the leading chances again. BAZZAS LEGACY (8) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and has been placed in three of his past four starts. He enjoyed a nice trail throughout but held his own in reasonable time when second behind Cheers Poverty last week. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (2) is a fast beginner and led throughout to win at Mildura two starts ago. He pressured the leader throughout and did extremely well for third last week so he must be considered as a winning chance again. SHES POPPY (9) is also dropping back in class for this assignment and has the speed to be in the finish. She chased hard when second in a slick mile rate of 1.56.5 at Mildura two starts ago. SELECTIONS: WHITEHAVEN BEACH (7), BAZZAS LEGACY (8), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (2), SHES POPPY (9)

OVERVIEW: Plenty of hopes to kick-off the night of racing at Melton, but FREAK OUT (9) looks to find a suitable assignment in what is a slight drop in grade from recent outings. He was only beaten 14.7m in a slick 1:54.7 mile rate last time behind Foregone Conclusion and had similar margins in two runs before that after winning from the front in a 41-45 ratings event at Melton. This is an easier 0-41 clash and he should run well from nine. The Glenn Bull runners FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (8), who draws for a good trip behind speedy beginner OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (1), and SHEZABLUECHIP (3), who has been brave despite tough trips her past couple, look good chances, while GOODTIME MAE (6) is among a host of others that wouldn’t surprise with the right trip. Tough start! SELECTIONS: FREAK OUT (9), FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (8), SHEZABLUECHIP (3), GOODTIME MAE (6)

OVERVIEW: Another race where you can make a case for quite a few, but siding with KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9) from the back row. He looks to be the horse contesting the best races of late, and he has been very competitive in doing so. He had no real chance last weekend when settling at the tail in a race won by leader Vici Bloom, but before that sat parked and only went down 4.6m to Sky Flair, who has won again since. That was in a 0-75 ratings race, and this is a drop back to a 56-64 event. The in-form DISTANT SUN (7) is a good chance despite the wide gate. He was a big winner two starts back for Blake Pace when unleashing a great turn of foot to run down Ox Knox at Kilmore, and was very brave when second to SEBASTIANS WAITING (8) at the same track when bringing up the running line from near the tail on August 6. The latter ruined his chances of back-to-back wins when galloping early last start but was only beaten 11.2m and is a handy type, while SCAR (4) might be a chance to get down to the fence and perhaps heads the rest of the winning chances. BACK: KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9), DISTANT SUN (7), SEBASTIANS WAITING (8), SCAR (4)

OVERVIEW: Such a hard race to map over the 1200m, but PISTOL PEARCE (5) might have the early toe to cross at the start and from there would take a lot of beating across a distance where the fence is gold. He’s certainly no superstar, but he did lead and win here at Melton last time out and also at Geelong in a slick last half on June 19. BULLETPROOF KID (2) has been runner-up his past three and looks a logical danger, while HITCH TO HIS STAR (9) and HITTHEROADJACK (8) are probably the class factors but have awkward draws to navigate. Both have good form around nice horses at Melton on a Saturday night and can certainly win if the tempo is frantic up top, as can HIGHLANDHARTBREAKA (7). SELECTIONS: PISTOL PEARCE (5), BULLETPROOF KID (2), HITCH TO HIS STAR (9), HITTHEROADJACK (8)

OVERVIEW: MISS MUSCLE (5) is a two-year-old trotter up against mostly older horses, but looks fairly smart and might be able to add a second career win to her resume. She won in good style at Melton two starts back and then chased home the very handy Phoenix Rex for third after that, getting close to Regal Gala who has won since. THE CHOOK (1) draws for a nice trip, and while disappointing as favourite last time out at Kilmore, has run some good races prior and looks a threat. SHES SKY HIGH (8) should lob a nice spot on the fence and is dropping back in grade a shade, while DREAMS OF LOVE (2) looks a chance of crossing down to the fence where she would run a good race second-up from a break. HOLD THAT MAGIC (9) has trialled okay since her last run and is one to factor in for wider exotics, and while two-year-old MAJARO GIRL (3) might start well in the market, I haven’t been overly taken by her two runs for the Andy Gath yard. BACK: MISS MUSCLE (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MISS MUSCLE (5), THE CHOOK (1), SHES SKY HIGH (8), DREAMS OF LOVE (2)

OVERVIEW: Looks plenty of speed off the front line here and it won’t be easy for THE FINAL DANCE (1), but he has started odds-on in all four runs since joining the Emma Stewart stable and won two of them in good style. The defeats had excuses, including last time over 1200m when he was crossed at the start and had to do work. He still closed well and was only beaten 5.4m by the handy Insider Trading. He’s no moral, but from the draw he goes on top. FIRE MARSHALL (10) hasn’t been seen at the trials since his last run on June 13, which was a brave death-seat fourth to the seasoned Clymenus. This followed a number of nice efforts on Saturday nights at Melton and he’s certainly a contender first-up from a freshen. TIVOLI (8) should get a nice run in behind THE FINAL DANCE (1) and is very capable in this grade, while MONTANA PRIDE (9) chased down ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (7) on August 3 and then wasn’t beaten far last time out behind Pistol Pearce. Those two are also contenders in a race where you can make a case for plenty of runners. SELECTIONS: THE FINAL DANCE (1), FIRE MARSHALL (10), TIVOLI (8), MONTANA PRIDE (9)

OVERVIEW: LENARD ESS (1) is a veteran of 195 career starts and loves the peg-line runs, which he will get here. He hasn’t done much his last couple when off the fence, but did run a nice second to the handy The Last Trip at Geelong recently and should give this a real shake from barrier one if he can do enough to boot up and perhaps take a sit on fast beginner SPUN SILVER (5). MISS PIGGY WIGGY (9) closed off okay from the rear in the race won by SPUN SILVER (5) at Melton last week and can improve on that with a different race shape over the 2240m, WOODLEA DIEGO (2) is another of the quick starters off the front line and is a winning factor, while the grey SPUN SILVER (5) is probably better suited over the shorter trips, but is flying at the moment and will give herself a chance if she can again find her favourite spot out in front. SELECTIONS: LENARD ESS (1), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (9), WOODLEA DIEGO (2), SPUN SILVER (5)

OVERVIEW: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) has trialled really nicely at Cobram since her fourth placing here at Melton on August 7 when she made an early break but still did a great job to only be beaten 14.5m. She was only nabbed in the shadows of the post by the in-form Spirited Lass prior to that and her first-up win during July was very good. While her manners are always a concern, a faultless display will have her hard to beat, particularly if she finds the front. Great to see the return of last season’s Victorian 2YO Trotting Filly of the Year HARPERSEVEN (6), who heads into her first run as a three-year-old on the back of three trials. She won the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final last season and must be respected in this grade. MET WITH A SHRUG (1) is going great guns for Team Murphy and chased well for second behind the smart The Preacher last time, while KEAYANG MINNESOTA (8) is two from two this campaign and is the other key winning hope alongside the unbeaten LORD LOGAN (3), who has been so impressive despite death seat trips in two wins to start his career. BACK: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2), HARPERSEVEN (6), MET WITH A SHRUG (1), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (8)

OVERVIEW: FANTASY FLIGHT (8) was $1.10 favourite last time at Kilmore when he galloped early and ruined his chances at the start. Nothing went right there and we should go off his prior first-up run when he found the front, gave a great kick and was only nailed late by Bay Of Fires in good time. There was a huge margin back to third and he looks ready to break his maiden at the eighth time of asking. SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (1) was super at the trials last time out when coming from a mile back to win at Melton and looks a good chance on debut, SWEET FLORABEL (5) beat the aforementioned rival home when second at her only trial appearance on August 4 and is another that steps out on debut, while BETTER THEN DAICOS (3) showed gate speed to lead last time at Shepparton, and despite dropping out there was well fancied in the market and is best of the rest alongside ARRIVAL TIME (6). BACK: FANTASY FLIGHT (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: FANTASY FLIGHT (8), SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (1), BETTER THEN DAICOS (3), SWEET FLORABEL (5)

OVERVIEW: DONNYOSKO (4) is the most experienced horse in this field of two-year-old trotters and she’s shown enough ability in her five starts to suggest she’s capable of winning a maiden this season. She broke when in a striking position during a recent trial at Maryborough, but her first-up run when fourth at the same track on August 3 was serviceable and her efforts before a spell earlier in the year were sound. SNOWIN (3) chased home race winner Rose All Day to only be beaten 4m in a trial at Kilmore and steps out on debut for the powerhouse Andy Gath yard, no vision was available for KYVALLEY DRIFTER’s (1) trial at Melton on August 11 but she won that and also hails from a strong trotting stable, while LUSTROUS (5) has been okay in a couple of trial hit-outs ahead of his debut. A race where we will learn a bit! THE TIGER ARMY (2) has gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position in this race from a good draw. He was running on nicely late behind Rock Hammer last time out at this track. LUKA DONCIC (1) has very little gate speed which could see him shuffled back in the early stages of this race. He was crossed last time out. He was running on late into third there behind Bling The Noise and a similar effort should see him thereabouts again. ULTIMATE ARK (10) should secure a good run off the speed in this race. Secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was running on nicely late into second behind Shez A Punter. VINNIE NITRO (6) has been in very good form recently but does draw poorly in this race and may be shuffled back. She secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on nicely into second behind Little Hoofananny. SELECTIONS: THE TIGER ARMY (2), LUKA DONCIC (1), ULTIMATE ARK (10), VINNIE NITRO (6) SUGGESTED BET: THE TIGER AMRY (2) to win.

ROCK NIEN (1) has good early speed and should be able to work through to lead in this race. He led early three starts ago before eventually relenting to the pressure being applied by STILLYOURSHOT (7) and ran a solid second there. He should lead for a long way. STILLYOURSHOT (7) worked to the front last time out and did plenty for work there before just being run down late by the horse on his back QUIK CHANGE (9). He should get a good run through early and should be hard to hold out late. BIZZIE LIZZIE (3) had no luck last time out when shuffled a long way back early in a race taken out by QUIK CHANGE (9). She draws well in this race and has good gate speed which should see her settle in a prominent position. QUIK CHANGE (9) was able to zip across early last time out before taking a sit and running by STILLYOURSHOT (7) late. Should get a good run off the speed in this race and would be suited by a genuine early tempo. SELECTIONS: ROCK NIEN (1), STILLYOURSHOT (7), BIZZIE LIZZIE (3), QUIK CHANGE (9) SUGGESTED BET: STILLYOURSHOT (7) to win.

BRACKEN WARRIOR (1) has reasonable early speed and should be able to drive through and lead this race. He appeared quite unlucky last time out when getting back and running on late behind Theresachance at this track. He should be hard to run down. SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (8) has been racing in good form recently. He got back in the run last time out and was finishing it off well into fourth behind Magicol Ideal. He is likely to get a good run again and should be hard to hold out. PRINCE JOY (7) should get a good run through early in this race behind a horse which is likely to be keen to lead. He led last start and copped plenty of pressure there battling on well for fourth. ROCK IT BABY (4) was left without cover last time out and battled away reasonably there for sixth. He should find this a touch easier and with a similar run could play a part in this race. SELECTIONS: BRACKEN WARRIOR (1), SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (8), PRINCE JOY (7), ROCK IT BABY (4) SUGGESTED BET: BRACKEN WARRIOR (1) to win.

CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (5) worked to the breeze last time out and was very good there battling away for a strong second over the 2040 at this track. He draws wide in this race but can be put into it at the right time and should run another good race. VODKA EN ICE (6) draws poorly outside the front row but does look well graded. Got back last time out and was making up late ground behind Shez A Warrior. He is likely to find this significantly easier. TRACER BULLET (1) has generally been a horse who does some of his best work when able to lead in his races. He finds a race where he should be able to drive through and lead which could see him turn his form around in this race. AQUA CRUISER (7) should get a good run through early in this race on the back of his stablemate. He ran a good race last time out finishing second behind Its Back Page News. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (5), VODKA EN ICE (6), TRACER BULLET (1), AQUA CRUISER (7) SUGGESTED BET: CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (5) to win.

SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (1) has plenty of gate speed and should be able to work through and lead early. She was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well enough there for sixth given she is not a horse that has previously been suited doing too much work in races. DIGBY DEVIL (7) has been racing in very good form recently and comes up with a favourable draw in this race. He secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on well into third behind Erasmus and Terragong Swinger. NEED NOT TO WARRY (3) has had close to a month between race starts coming into this race. He has been in good form recently and was good in sixth in a stronger race which was taken out by Opallane. FRANCS FOR COMING (5) was well beaten last time out after being left without cover over the 2040. He was able to lead his start prior and beat Luvn Osman who has since won. SELECTIONS: SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (1), DIGBY DEVIL (7), NEED NOT TO WARRY (3), FRANCS FOR COMING (5) SUGGESTED BET: SHEEZ GOT TORQUE (1) to win.

THATS CLASSIC (7) had no luck when badly checked and making a break last time out. He ran well two starts ago finishing third behind Usual Suspect in good time for the grade after sitting without cover. He will need luck but looks hard to beat. PERFECT LOU (8) secured a good run on the pegs last time out at was held up at a crucial stage there appearing to travel nicely behind them. He should be able to secure a good run off the speed and can be running on late again. SINKRATE (5) appeared to struggle out wide on the track last time out when not being able to get around the field to the breeze. Once he was able to get into the clear he finished it off well enough considering how long he was wide on the track. COCOLYN (1) should be able to secure a good run from the ideal draw. She ran well for second last time out at this track behind Wicked De Lil. SELECTIONS: THATS CLASSIC (7), PERFECT LOU (8), SINKRATE (5), COCOLYN (1) SUGGESTED BET: THATS CLASSIC (7) to win.

LITTLE WHIPPET (9) was able to secure a good run last time out after doing some early work to find a position. He just didn’t seem to run out the 2040 getting tired late when fading into fifth. He should be suited doing no work early and stepping back to 1780. DEEP REGRET (8) was shuffled back last time out at Marburg and just couldn’t get into the race late there. He seems to be a horse which is best suited when able to get up on speed and may be put into this race at some stage. EMMALEEN (6) wasn’t beaten far two starts ago when sixth behind Last Call at this track. She is likely to be shuffled back from a wide draw but should be running on strongly late in this company. DIAMOND DEANO (4) led last time out and battled on for a good third there over the 2040 at this track behind Malibu Dream. He should be able to work forward and could run another good race if he finds the front. SELECTIONS: LITTLE WHIPPET (9), DEEP REGRET (8), EMMALEEN (6), DIAMOND DEANO (4) SUGGESTED BET: LITTLE WHIPPET (9) to win.

DIVINE ABUNDANCE (1) showed gate speed last time out before ducking onto the pegs and running well for fourth at Albion Park. She comes into this race third up from a spell and should be nearing peak fitness. COBBITY CADENCE (2) got a long way back last time out at Albion Park and was running on well into third behind Mackenzie Reg. She is likely to be suited in what appears to be a race with a touch less depth. EXIT STAGE LEFT (8) ran fairly last time out when finishing fourth behind Maywyn Valeinto at this track. Should be fitter for that recent outing and draws well in this race. SAUV BLANC (4) still seems to be working out how to race having done a few things wrong last time out behind Shine Like Me. She should be suited dropping back into a maiden. SELECTIONS: DIVINE ABUNDANCE (1), COBBITY CADENCE (2), EXIT STAGE LEFT (8), SAUV BLANC (4) SUGGESTED BET: DIVINE ABUNDANCE (1) to win.

CAPTAINS RUN (8) looked very unlucky last start when running into plenty of traffic through the concluding stages in a race taken out by Charmed Conquest. He appears to be dropping into a much easier race and draws reasonably on the back row. AESETHETE (3) got a long way back last start and was running on nicely iinto second behind Maywyn Valentino who proved a dominant winner in that race. He appears to draw favourably on the front row in this race and should be hard to beat. AMIEES ALIAS (5) got back in the run last time out and was finishing it off well behind Mackenzie Reg at Albion Park. She draws awkwardly this time and will likely need a few things to go her way in the run. OLIVIA RHAYNE BOW (4) secured a good run last time out behind the leader and ran on fairly late into third behind Maywyn Valentino. The draw on paper appears a touch awkward. SELECTIONS: CAPTAINS RUN (8), AESETHETE (3), AMIEES ALIAS (5), OLIVIA RHAYNE BOW (4) SUGGESTED BET: AESETHETE (3) to win.
